mapper.insert: INSERT INTO message ( user_id, content, create_time, update_time, status ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{content}, NOW(), NOW(), #{status} )
mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.user_id, m.content, m.create_time, m.update_time, m.status FROM message m WHERE m.status = #{status} ORDER BY m.create_time DESC, m.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT m.id, m.user_id, m.content, m.create_time, m.update_time, m.status FROM message m WHERE m.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE message SET status = 0, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.user_id, m.content, m.create_time, m.update_time, m.status, u.username, u.teamname FROM message m LEFT JOIN user u ON m.user_id = u.id WHERE m.status = 1 ORDER BY m.create_time DESC, m.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message WHERE status = 1
SELECT m.id, m.user_id, m.content, m.create_time, m.update_time, m.status, u.username, u.teamname FROM message m LEFT JOIN user u ON m.user_id = u.id WHERE m.id = #{id} AND m.status = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE message SET status = 0, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.user_id, m.content, m.create_time, m.update_time, m.status, u.username, u.teamname FROM message m LEFT JOIN user u ON m.user_id = u.id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 1 ORDER BY m.create_time DESC, m.id DESC
